overall: The AG found the Building Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of its April 12, 2017 meeting at Town Hall, rejecting the claim that the May 3 re-vote cured it, and ordered no additional relief.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Building Committee failed to post notice of its April 12, 2017 meeting on the Town Hall bulletin board.
allegations.key_passage: Indeed, the Committee's response concedes that notice was not properly posted.

allegations.summary: Committee argued its May 3 meeting, which re-voted April 12 actions and adopted the April 12 record, cured the posting violation; AG disagreed.
allegations.key_passage: we nonetheless find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law with respect to the April 12 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint contained allegations that would not constitute Open Meeting Law violations even if true; AG declined to review them.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint contains allegations that, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law

allegations.summary: Request for further review raised allegations not in the original complaint; AG declined to review them.
allegations.key_passage: We do not review these allegations, either.

allegations.summary: Request for further review asked the AG to conduct a broad audit of all Committee meetings; AG declined.
allegations.key_passage: we note that our office does not conduct such audits.
